description: Write the researcher profile text and/or the academic social networks. Networks are MERGED over what CvLAC already stores — its form rewrites the whole table, so this reads it first and posts everything back. Pass url:null to remove one. A network CvLAC does not list goes in "otro" with its name in "label". Removing one needs confirm_delete:true. The profile text cannot be blanked: CvLAC marks it required. The areas list is replaced whole, so dropping one also needs confirm_delete:true.

areas.description: The whole list of áreas de actuación, in order — the first is the main one — by name or by CvLAC code. It replaces what is stored, so anything left out is a removal. An ambiguous name comes back in "choices" instead of being guessed.

confirm_delete.description: Required when a network carries url:null or the areas list drops one. Without it nothing is written.

description.description: Replaces the profile text. Omit to leave it untouched.

networks.description: Networks to set or remove. Everything else stored is kept.

label.description: Only for network:"otro" — the name CvLAC stores beside the URL

network.description: One of: google_scholar, researchgate, ssr, ssrn, academia_edu, mendeley, linkedin, repositorios_disciplinares, repositorios_institucionales, researcher_id, scopus_author_id, orcid, otro

url.description: The profile URL, or null to remove this network

name: update_profile
